item.text:
Provides order-total calculation, discount application, average item price, and formatted receipt output.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`, so its last iteration reads `items[items.length]` and throws (`price` of `undefined`). Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides an order total (which includes quantities) by the number of distinct items; it’s only correct if “average” means line-item total, not per-unit price.
- `averageItemPrice([])` returns `NaN`; handle empty arrays if they’re valid input.
